questions.q: The primary source of energy for the Earth's climate system is:
questions.solution: Solar radiation supplies the main energy input driving Earth’s climate system.

questions.q: Who has the authority to declare a financial emergency in India?
questions.solution: Article 360 empowers the President to proclaim a financial emergency.

questions.q: Which of the following is the capital of Bangladesh?
questions.solution: Dhaka is Bangladesh’s capital. The other options are Bangladeshi cities.

questions.q: Which day is observed as the 'International Disarmament and Non-Proliferation Awareness Day' every year?
questions.solution: The UN observes International Day for Disarmament and Non-Proliferation Awareness on 5 March.

questions.q: Recently, which Indian airport received recognition at UNESCO's 2023 Prix Versailles ?
questions.solution: Bengaluru’s Kempegowda International Airport received the 2023 Prix Versailles recognition referred to here.

questions.q: Which international agreement focuses on the protection of the ozone layer by phasing out the production of numerous substances responsible for ozone depletion ?
questions.solution: The Montreal Protocol controls ozone-depleting substances. The Paris Agreement addresses climate change.

questions.q: Which Indian scheme aims to provide a pension to unorganized workers, assuring a minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after the age of 60 years?
options: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
questions.solution: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan provides the specified pension framework for eligible unorganised workers.

questions.q: "The Chronicles of Narnia" series is written by whom?
questions.solution: C. S. Lewis wrote The Chronicles of Narnia series.

questions.q: The number of people entering a population through 'birth' or immigration' being equal to the number of people leaving it via 'emigration' or 'death' is called:
questions.solution: When additions through births and immigration equal losses through deaths and emigration, population size has zero net growth.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) programme?
questions.solution: ITEC offers technical cooperation, capacity building and training to partner countries.

questions.q: Who was the first Sultan of Delhi ?
questions.solution: Qutb-ud-din Aibak established the Delhi Sultanate’s first ruling dynasty in 1206.

questions.q: Who discovered Nitrogen ?
questions.solution: Daniel Rutherford identified nitrogen in 1772.

questions.q: Which of the following is the GST common portal?
questions.solution: The GST common portal uses the government domain gst.gov.in.

questions.q: Which mountain is called the 'Blue Mountain'?
questions.solution: Nilgiri literally refers to blue mountains. The Nilgiri Hills are in southern India.

questions.q: What is meant by a 'trade deficit'?
options: When a country's trade is balanced
When a country's imports exceed its exports
When a country's exports exceed its imports
When a country has no trade at all
questions.solution: A trade deficit occurs when import value exceeds export value.

questions.q: Name the traditional form of wrestling in Uttar Pradesh (including other States), which wrestlers practice in a specially prepared mud pit called an Akhada.
questions.solution: Kushti or Pehalwani is the traditional wrestling practised in an Akhada’s prepared earth pit.

questions.q: The structure of DNA was discovered by whom?
questions.solution: Watson and Crick proposed the DNA double-helix structure, drawing on evidence including Rosalind Franklin’s work.

questions.q: Which of the following cybercrimes involves deceiving individuals into revealing sensitive information?
questions.solution: Phishing uses deception to obtain sensitive information such as passwords or banking details.

questions.q: The first Indian to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature was
questions.solution: Rabindranath Tagore received the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature.

questions.q: Which is the capital of Germany?
questions.solution: Berlin is Germany’s capital.

questions.q: Trojan virus was released on numerous SolarWinds Orion Platforms.
questions.solution: SUNBURST was the malware associated with the SolarWinds Orion supply-chain compromise.

questions.q: Which organization provides loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries ?
questions.solution: The World Bank supplies development finance, including loans and grants for poorer countries.

questions.q: Which day is celebrated as 'World Art Day' every year?
questions.solution: World Art Day is observed on 15 April.

questions.q: Article 352 of the Indian Constitution primarily deals with:
options: Proclamation of dissolution of the Lok Sabha
Proclamation of the formation of a new state
questions.solution: Article 352 concerns the proclamation of a national emergency. Financial emergency is under Article 360.

questions.q: Which programme was launched by the Indian Government to promote entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities?
questions.solution: Stand-Up India was designed to support entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe borrowers.

questions.q: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by:
questions.solution: Harihara and Bukka founded the Vijayanagara Empire in 1336.

questions.q: Mega cities are the cities having a population more than
questions.solution: The usual megacity threshold is a population exceeding ten million.

questions.q: Who is the current Director-General of WTO?
questions.solution: For the paper’s August 2024 context, the WTO Director-General was Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.

questions.q: The celebrated novel 'The Godfather' was authored by whom?
questions.solution: Mario Puzo wrote The Godfather, published in 1969.

questions.q: What is the full form of PAN?
questions.solution: PAN stands for Permanent Account Number.
